identical_hypothesis.note: hypothesis == reference, one switch (he->en). Every rate is 0; switch_penalty_ratio is undefined (0/0), not a crash.

neutral_digit_does_not_suppress_switch.note: a neutral digit token sitting between a Hebrew and an English token does not hide the switch (S3). Expect exactly one switch point: (1, 3).

overlapping_windows_merge.hypothesis: א ב google day ה ו
overlapping_windows_merge.note: two switches, (1,2) and (3,4), whose W=3 windows overlap and merge into one union covering all 6 tokens. n_window_tokens must be 6, not 5+5.

errors_inside_window_only.hypothesis: א ב ג ד other day ה ו ט י
errors_inside_window_only.note: switches at (3,4) and (5,6); W=3 union window = {1..8}, outside = {0,9}. Substituting index 4 (google->other, inside window) drives switch_adjacent_wer up while non_switch_wer stays exactly 0. switch_penalty_ratio is then non-zero/zero -> reported as 'inf', not a crash.

errors_outside_window_only.note: same ref as errors_inside_window_only. Substituting index 0 (outside the window) leaves switch_adjacent_wer at exactly 0 while non_switch_wer rises.

insertion_both_bounding_in_window.hypothesis: א ב ג ד google extra day ה ו ט י
insertion_both_bounding_in_window.note: insertion gap p=5 is bounded by ref index 4 and ref index 5, both inside the {1..8} window -> attributed to the window (switch_adjacent_wer rises), non_switch_wer stays 0.

insertion_no_window_token_either_side.reference: א ב google ג ד ה ו ז ח ט י day כ ל
insertion_no_window_token_either_side.hypothesis: א ב google ג ד ה ו extra ז ח ט י day כ ל
insertion_no_window_token_either_side.note: each isolated foreign word (google, day) produces TWO switch points (entering and leaving), so windows are wider than a single switch would suggest: union window = {0,1,2,3,4,5,8,9,10,11,12,13} (n=12), leaving two consecutive outside tokens at indices {6,7}. An insertion at gap p=7, bounded by (6,7) which are BOTH outside the window, is NOT attributed to the window: switch_adjacent_wer stays 0, non_switch_wer rises to 1/2.

insertion_mixed_boundary.reference: א ב ג ד ה google ו ז ח ט
insertion_mixed_boundary.hypothesis: א ב extra ג ד ה google ו ז ח ט
insertion_mixed_boundary.note: the isolated foreign word (google, index 5) produces TWO switch points -- (4,5) and (5,6) -- so the W=3 union window is {2,3,4,5,6,7,8} (n=7), outside={0,1,9}. Insertion gap p=2 is bounded by ref index 1 (outside window) and ref index 2 (inside window) -- a genuine mixed boundary. The 'at least one in-window' rule means this IS attributed to the window: switch_adjacent_wer rises to 1/7 even though one side is outside; non_switch_wer stays 0 (all three outside tokens are unchanged).
